verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair ask for a framework and storage-backed knowledge product, so the axis applies. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec: every candidate path returned 404. The llms.txt file and markdown docs are LLM-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
